Container.Name: Chore
Container.Overview: Production Chore deployment. Access the application through the HTTPS hostname configured by APP_FQDN and the Cloudflare Tunnel. Direct LAN HTTP is intentionally not configured as the WebUI.

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Host port forwarded to Chore's internal port 8000. Cloudflare Tunnel may use http://UNRAID_LAN_IP:4523 as its origin.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent production SQLite database and application-level backups.

Config.Name: Application FQDN
Config.Description: Production hostname only, without https://, a path, or a port.

Config.Name: Django Debug
Config.Description: Must remain false for container deployments.

Config.Name: Django Secret Key
Config.Description: Long, random production-only Django secret key.

Config.Name: Django Log Level
Config.Description: Application console logging level.

Config.Name: HSTS Seconds
Config.Description: Keep 0 during initial HTTPS validation; enable only when this hostname is permanently HTTPS-only.

Config.Name: Deployment Mode
Config.Description: Production container mode.

Config.Name: Database Path
Config.Description: Persistent production SQLite database path inside the container.

Config.Name: Backup Directory
Config.Description: Application-level SQLite backup directory inside persistent appdata.

Config.Name: Backup Retention
Config.Description: Number of daily application backups retained.

Config.Name: Backups Enabled
Config.Description: Must remain true for production.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Fixed Chore business timezone.

Config.Name: Email Enabled
Config.Description: Enable production Manager-report email delivery.

Config.Name: Email Host
Config.Description: Production SMTP hostname.

Config.Name: Email Port
Config.Description: Production SMTP port.

Config.Name: Email TLS
Config.Description: Use STARTTLS for production SMTP.

Config.Name: Email Username
Config.Description: Gmail address used for SMTP authentication.

Config.Name: Email App Password
Config.Description: Gmail App Password; do not use the normal account password.

Config.Name: Default From Email
Config.Description: Sender address shown on Manager-report email.
